hash_basis: SHA-256 of bytes in the pinned local checkout; target formatting and typed adaptations differ intentionally.

ports.changes: Preserve normalized ToolCall/Usage/Response; finish_reason allows None so dropped streams cannot silently become stop.
Original lock-based counter; add explicit typing and local formatting; no upstream configuration or default runtime budget.
Original repetition algorithms and stream watch; wider input annotation matches defensive type guard.
Original text projection helpers; explicit casts for strict checking, no upstream imports.
Keep slot reassignment and fragment aggregation; public local class name, typed containers, both eager and lazy upstream imports removed.
Port field:23-30 and model-dump helpers:1544-1554; only local SDK value inspection.

Port normalization:689-779, stream completeness:3256-3346 and reasoning replay behavior; AsyncOpenAI injected, SDK retries disabled; incomplete tool JSON is rejected rather than repaired. Uses the project-owned strict JSON-object parser: rejects duplicate decoded keys and non-finite numeric values before dispatch.

Preserve iteration/request/response/tool/final order:1656-1709 and persist-before-dispatch:76-177. Replace giant AIAgent, phase reflection, leases, plugins, CLI hooks with RunPorts. Stop/stale closes unexecuted calls; inflight work is retained and late actual result recorded. Stable call-id fallback/uniqueness follows upstream algorithm with local names. Uses the project-owned strict JSON-object parser: rejects duplicate decoded keys and non-finite numeric values before dispatch.
Port changing-ID fragment and same-name split behaviors; add SDK MockTransport/protocol/extra-content/disabled-retry tests.
Keep budget concurrency/exhaustion assertion and repetition behavior; no upstream test harness import.

notes: Only the required OpenAI Chat Completions wire path is implemented. Other upstream provider-specific signatures/transports are not claimed supported.
SDK mock probe validates actual installed SDK and HTTP/SSE codec with synthetic data, not a real model service.
Tool schema/authorization/effect deduplication and durable unknown blockers belong to application RunPorts/ToolExecutor, not SDK normalization.
